fullPassage: To tantalize someone is to make them want something, often something they can never get. The word comes from the Greek myth of King Tantalus, who was so proud that he tried to fool the gods. When invited to eat with them, Tantalus stole their special food so that he could bring it to his friends. As a punishment, he was sent to the underworld. He had to stand in a pool of water with delicious ripe fruit hanging from a tree above him. Whenever he tried to drink the water, it would drain away. If he tried to pick the fruit, the branches would move out of reach. Tantalus was already in the underworld, so no matter how hungry or thirsty he got, he would never die.

② sent: 'he was sent' be동사 + 과거분사(수동태) — 적절

③ drink: 'tried to drink' to부정사 뒤 동사원형 — 적절

④ die: 'he would never die' 조동사 would 뒤 동사원형 — 적절

questions.passage: To tantalize someone is to make them want something, often something they can never get. The word comes from the Greek myth of King Tantalus, who was so proud that he tried to fool the gods. When invited to eat with them, Tantalus stole <u>their</u> special food so that he could bring it to his friends. As a punishment, he was sent to the underworld. He had to stand in a pool of water with delicious ripe fruit hanging from a tree above him. Whenever he tried to drink the water, it would drain away. If he tried to pick the fruit, the branches would move out of reach. Tantalus was already in the underworld, so no matter how hungry or thirsty he got, he would never die.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 their가 가리키는 대상으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: their = the gods(신들). 'stole their special food' = 신들의 특별한 음식을 훔침
det.analysis:
밑줄 their(그들의)는 앞에 나온 the gods(신들)를 가리켜요.

앞 문장에서 탄탈로스가 'the gods(신들)'를 속이려 했고, 이어서 신들과 함께 먹도록 초대받았을 때 'their special food(그들의=신들의 특별한 음식)'를 훔쳤다고 했어요 → 신들 ←정답

② 친구들: 훔친 음식을 '가져다줄' 대상이지 음식의 주인이 아니에요

③ 저승의 망령들: 아직 저승 이야기가 나오기 전이에요

④ 가족: 본문에 없어요
det.tip: stole their food = 신들의 음식. their = the gods

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 그의 머리 위(above him)에 맛있게 익은 과일이 '나무에 매달려' 있음 → hanging from a tree
det.analysis:
빈칸 문장: '그는 물웅덩이에 서 있어야 했고, 맛있게 익은 과일이 그의 머리 위에 __________ 있었다.'

뒤의 'above him(그의 위에)'과 형벌 상황(따려 하면 가지가 물러남)으로 보아 과일은 '나무에 매달려' 있어야 해요 → hanging from a tree(나무에 매달린) ←정답

① buried under the snow(눈 속에 묻힌): 위에 있는 과일과 반대

③ floating on the water(물 위에 뜬): 물은 그의 발밑에 있어요

④ locked inside a box(상자 안에 갇힌): 문맥과 무관해요
det.tip: above him(위에) + branches(가지) → 과일은 나무에 매달림

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①은 어법상 틀렸다. 어법에 맞게 올바른 형태로 고쳐 (1단어, 영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: stealed → stole (steal은 불규칙 동사, 과거형은 stole)
det.analysis:
밑줄 친 부분은 'Tantalus ① stealed their special food' 자리예요.

→ steal(훔치다)은 불규칙 동사라서 과거형에 -ed를 붙인 stealed가 아니에요.
→ steal의 과거형은 stole이에요. (steal - stole - stolen)
→ 그래서 stealed를 stole로 고쳐 써요.

원문: 'Tantalus stole their special food'
det.tip: steal은 불규칙 동사. 과거형 = stole (stealed 아님)
